description: Leave a room. Members see a 'left' notice. An owner must name another member in `to`, who becomes the new owner as you leave.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

to.description: Owner only: slug or display name of the member who takes over the room

name: huddo_leave
